meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 执行 Bash 命令时,输出经 rtk 压缩,节省 60–90% token。对 Claude 透明,无需额外指令。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要执行任意 Bash 命令时触发,如 git、cargo、pytest 等。

say.text: 请运行 git status,告诉我当前仓库状态。
执行 pytest 测试,并总结失败项。
say.note: 命令输出经 rtk 压缩后返回。

say.text: 运行 docker ps 查看容器列表。
say.note: 输出同样经 rtk 过滤。

howto.what_en: After install, when Claude runs a Bash command, the output is filtered through the rtk compression proxy, saving 60–90% tokens. Transparent to Claude; no extra instructions needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever Claude is about to run any Bash command, e.g. git, cargo, pytest, etc.

say_en.text: Run git status and tell me the current repo state.
Run docker ps to list containers.
